notes.title: Playtest in one Week: Localization.
notes.content:
[p]I have been asked many times about localisation to different languages. 

We will have the full game translated to the advertised languages on launch day, done by a professional team. 

In the meantime, the CRETE community is helping me to localise a big part of CRETE into different languages.

This won't be the final translation, it won't be all the game, and it won't be perfect, but it will be good enough to have an improved experience if you are not English speaker.

I want to thank all players helping me with this process! 
And if you want to help localise CRETE to your language, consider joining us on Discord. You can find it in:

[url="www.cretegame.com" style="button"]www.cretegame.com[/url]

notes.title: New Feature: Genetic Blueprints.
notes.content:
[p]Genetic Blueprints: Work in Progress.[/p][previewyoutube="RohJ0EnMkTs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

The entire mechanic of buying a weapon with samples or experimenting with random samples in Biolabs will be gone and revamped in a more interesting, clean -yet deeper- system: Genetic Blueprints. Genetic Blueprints are "formulas" that you will find in Ancestor's settlements. They are just the recipes to build weapons, abilities and now even Permanent and Ephemeral (One run only) mutations. These Genetic Blueprints still require the ingredients: [/p][list][*][p]DNA Samples: Different combinations, similar to a talent tree.,[/p][/*][*][p]Proto-Genes: 100 of them, with 5 qualities and 0-100 integrities. They also have a collection signature with time, date, location and source. If you don't need one of them, collect it!,[/p][/*][*][p]RNA Guide: To guide the Cas9 Molecule, a mandatory element to make gene editing possible.,[/p][/*][*][p]Optional: Enhancers, Stabilisers.[/p][/*][/list][p]If that is not enough, Proto-genes are droppable and exchangeable with other players. And your Evolution tree will make specific Proto-Genes more valuable than others. 

More facts? Some Genetic Blueprints are in Ancestor's language, and only the Culture Evolution tree will be able to decipher these recipes. More?? Most Genetic Blueprints can be constructed in the Basecamp with human tech, with the peace of mind of being safe and having all the time in the world. But now, hear me well, hardcore players, some Genetic Blueprints will unlock bonuses if they are built in Ancestor's Laboratories. Meaning that you will have to bring and risk your Proto-Genes and perform the action while being in the Biome. 

YES, Proto-genes are lost if you die and they are not extracted. But no worries, at least Genetic Blueprints are forever. So be careful where you go with your cash out there. 

This is just scratching the surface, and one of the systems I'm really, really excited about since it offers tons of exploration and experimentation. Get ready [/p]

notes.title: CRETE Playtest Ends Now. Thank you!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43043832/81444df83b9d2e5fac79390815e0791de9a8f4bd.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

We’re closing the playtest effective immediately, and what a wild ride one more time!

As in previous playtests, CRETE has been improved thanks to all your feedback, hundreds of live streams, thousands of players and a growing community of skilled DNA Hunters. We have seen playstyles that we could never imagine, and memorable moments when someone defeated a first Kremidi, a first Guardian, a first Hephasteus... and a first Brontes.

We began this playtest with one biome and one boss; we’re ending it with two biomes, two bosses, and 41 patches. For a two‑person team, we’re pretty proud of that.

A heartfelt thank‑you as well to every new backer on Ko‑fi. Your support means the world to us and helps keep the project moving faster, more independently, and true to its original vision.
[b]
What’s next?[/b]
We plan to run two more public playtests this year, open to everyone, with no restrictions. The first will likely land in summer, the second in autumn. Potentially with a new Biome per playtest (+ Tons of other updates). We will announce a release date before the year ends. Keep an eye on Discord and our social channels for updates, or game media.
[b]
Can I keep playing now?[/b]
Yes, you can! Find more info on our website, where you can support us and buy the game now as an alpha. If you are not sure yet, better to wait for future playtests and see how things evolve. You can find more information on our Discord and ask any questions there.

[b]Localisation[/b]
Full localisation into all advertised languages will arrive with version 1.0 (official launch). However, we’ll start introducing translated elements sooner so backers can see progress. With just two people on the team, we need time to hire the right professionals and avoid re‑work, Thanks for your patience.

[b]Controller support & split‑screen[/b]
This year, we’re also targeting local co‑op split‑screen and full controller support.

That’s all for now. I’m humbled by the incredible reception CRETE has received—especially for a game where the first hour is mostly about dying.

As game director, I’m making the game I want to play to oblivion. If you miss tough games where you own both your defeats and your victories, welcome aboard, because that’s exactly our mission.

See you soon, DNA Hunters.

Álvaro

notes.title: Introducing ROUNDS
notes.content:
After our recent playtest we have collected a huge amount of useful data and feedback that is helping to make CRETE better. Thank you again!

While we will keep our tradition of doing [b]public playtests every 2 to 4 months[/b], we also want to improve our private playtests. We want to give everyone a chance to participate. It doesn't matter if you already have been in a CRETE playtest before or if you are new to this game. 

[b]ROUNDS will rotate 10 players every two weeks[/b], so we make sure that the experience is fresh and the feedback is sharp.
We want all sorts of players, from curated CRETE players to newcomers, from potato machines to spaceships, from those who die playing Animal Crossing to those who can beat Dark Souls blindfolded.

You just need to fill this form [url=https://www.cretegame.com/privaterounds]here[/url]:

notes.title: Current state of CRETE: 7 min Gameplay
notes.content:
We are very excited to share with you this video showing a raw and uncut gameplay of CRETE. Why the excitement? Because we are very close to doing our next public playtest and you will be the one fighting against the Ancestors and other Bizarre creatures.

Very soon we will announce the date of our playtest. But in the meantime, these are the things that we will feature and test:

-More weapons, enemies, landmarks, temples, challenges and events.
-Mutation system with 6 types of Mutations and 4 variations each of them + Rarity.
-The Island of CRETE to build your weapons and progress.
-Combat 2.0 with refactored energy and ability system.
-Tons of polishing and quality of life improvements.

[previewyoutube=spE0AgjnBzc;full][/previewyoutube]
